business_problem: Home Credit Bank needed a safer enterprise AI environment that non-technical teams could use to build banking agents quickly without creating data-leak risk or relying on a long custom-development cycle for each new use case.
solution_summary: Home Credit Bank consolidated its AI work onto Gemini Enterprise so both business and technical teams could build banking agents inside a controlled environment. After migrating fully into the secure Gemini Enterprise setup, the bank began using no-code Agent Designer features to create a digital subject-matter expert that helps field officers determine customer financing eligibility from historical information. The same environment also enabled the CRM team to design and launch a churn-prediction agent in just two weeks, much faster than the prior approach, and that faster rollout improved customer conversion. By grounding workflows and internal knowledge inside Gemini Enterprise, the bank reduced the risk of employees pushing sensitive work into unmanaged tools while also making it much easier for business teams to build new agentic services themselves. The result is a secure, extensible foundation for compliant retail-banking AI.

Those agents then return guidance to employees and CRM workflows within the secure environment.
